bottleneck.name: Memory-level parallelism
bottleneck.detail: Waiting for a free MSHR costs 95% of cycles: the misses are independent but too few can be in flight at once.
bottleneck.suggestions: Increase cpu.mshrs; Reduce memory.latency_cycles to shorten MSHR occupancy; Improve locality so fewer misses need to be tracked

bottleneck.detail: DRAM is delivering 99% of its configured bandwidth, so requests are queueing behind the bus.
bottleneck.suggestions: Increase memory.bandwidth_gbps; Reduce DRAM traffic by improving locality (blocking/tiling); Increase last-level cache capacity to filter traffic

bottleneck.name: DRAM latency

bottleneck.suggestions: Increase l2.size_kb to keep the working set on chip; Reduce memory.latency_cycles; Increase cpu.mshrs if the misses are independent
